text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I will start a “revolution.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Smashing through rigid conventional wisdom 
with sheer strength— and elevating the 
level of Japanese Umamusume until they can 
take on the world—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That is my mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The reason why I am here at Tracen Academy 
right now—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—This is our first time talking like 
this, isn't it?”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: “...You are—”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I am Symboli Rudolf from Japan's Tracen 
Academy. I am also a distant relative of 
yours."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I heard about you from the one you look 
up to as a master. Though it may have been 
rude of me, I've been watching over your 
achievements from the shadows up until 
today."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Master is—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "I'll get straight to the point, Kris S."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Would you be willing to come to Japan, 
hone your running at Tracen Academy, and 
compete in Japanese races?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—Currently, Japanese Umamusume have a 
tendency to specialize in domestic 
Japanese racing."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"‘We sought to challenge that stalemate 
and foster Japan's Umamusume toward the 
global stage, searching for a spark to 
ignite a revolution.’"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'results' you have built up spoke 
far more eloquently of your potential as 
an Umamusume than anything I had heard."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Would you please consider becoming it? 
...The stone that will change the Japanese 
racing world."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—It begins. Starting tomorrow... 
everything.

Our three-year journey taking on the 
Twinkle Series with Symboli Kris S is 
finally about to begin...!

Today was the first day, and hoping to get 
off to a good start, I headed to the 
academy all fired up, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Way to School A
text_block_list.text:
K-Kris S-senpai?! Why is she standing over 
there like that...? Man, her presence is 
intimidating just standing there...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Way to School B
text_block_list.text:
Her aura is seriously insane. If she 
looked straight at me, I might cry...

Standing stiff as a board, Symboli Kris S 
was drawing strange looks from the other 
Umamusume on their way to school, so I 
hurriedly ran over.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning. —Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I was waiting for you. ...I want... to 
talk.

When I arrived at the Trainer's Office 
with Symboli Kris Sâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Goal. ...I want to confirm—and 
establish—our objective.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'm... not very good... at putting things 
into words.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
For that reasonâ I want to checkâand 
make sure first, before moving forward.

It seems Symboli Kris S wants to make sure 
we share the same clear understanding of 
our goals as we move forward together.
choice_data_list:
Once again, I want to hear Symboli Kris 
S's goal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—My mission... is achieved. —To spark a 
"revolution" in the Japanese racing world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —For that to happen... it's necessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――"Strength." ――Demonstrating a 
strength... that defies all common sense.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……However――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—My body is... frail. Far too frail—to 
fulfill my mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I have to change. —Unbreakable. Into a 
strong body."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...To become a strong Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—I want to hear... your thoughts. The 
way... to achieve our goal.”

Symboli Kris S's grand ambition. The 
obstacles standing in the way of achieving 
it. Taking both into account, I organize 
my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Impatience……――

The "revolution" she seeks. There are 
several ways to demonstrate the 
extraordinary "strength" needed to achieve 
it.

For instance, proactively entering races 
early in the Junior Class and letting the 
results speak for themselves is one 
possible approach—

However, just as Symboli Kris S coldly 
analysed herself, her "current" body still 
possesses a fragility that cannot be 
pushed too far...

The first thing we must do is strengthen 
Symboli Kris S herself...!

I write 'Junior Class,' 'Classic Class,' 
and 'Senior Class' on the whiteboard. 
Then, I draw a large circle around 'Junior 
Class'—
choice_data_list:
For your junior year, strengthening you is 
our top priority

For your junior year, strengthening you 
will be our top priority

text_block_list.text:
From her debut until the Classic Class, we 
will dedicate our time to building Symboli 
Kris S's physique and refrain from taking 
on early challenges. And then—
choice_data_list:
Let's show everyone your strength in the 
Classic Class and beyond.

Let's show everyone your strength in the 
Classic Class and beyond.

text_block_list.text:
I circled 'Classic Year' and 'Senior Year' 
together, and wrote 'Challenge!' beneath 
them in large, bold letters.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list:
...It's just a rough idea, but what do you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of a similar... plan. 
So—...thanks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... took into account my 
weakness—my body. You considered it—and 
adapted to it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...That is why I want to show my 
gratitude. And—live up to your 
expectations."

Hearing her speak with such pure honesty 
makes me want to give everything I have as 
her Trainer in return. That feeling wells 
up deep inside me—
choice_data_list:
Let's give training our all starting 
today!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

We then moved on to afternoon training, 
wrapping up our first day right on 
schedule—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Cool-down complete.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes. —Please drink it.

Taking the offered water and sipping as 
told, an indescribable refreshment 
instantly quenched my parched throat...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Necessity. ――Water is essential. It's 
something we drink daily... We cannot cut 
corners.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So—I will choose for myself. I will decide 
for myself. ……With reason, and with will.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Best—I will do my utmost best. Just like 
in our training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Once again— ...I look forward to working 
with you.

For the sake of her mission, she 
compromises on nothing and constantly 
seeks the best. I could feel her 
unyielding will even through the chill of 
the bottle in my hand—
choice_data_list:
I'll do everything in my power for the 
sake of your mission, too.

I'll do everything I can for your mission, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Thanks.

And so, our days of taking on challenges 
with Symboli Kris S began...!!
